summary: Shows calling a custom fact-gathering module at the start of tasks so the facts it returns can be used in later conditionals.
questions: How do I use my own custom facts in a when condition?
Can a custom module provide facts for later tasks?

answer_card.title: Using custom facts in conditionals
answer_card.answer_md:
Call your custom fact module first; its returned variables are available afterward:

```yaml
- name: Gather site specific fact data
  action: site_facts
- ansible.builtin.command: /usr/bin/thingy
  when: my_custom_fact_just_retrieved_from_the_remote_system == '1234'
```
